scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,server,client -c yellow,green,cyan "npm run db" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.setup: node scripts/with-db.mjs "npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run seed -w server"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
